findings.title: Removed/renamed functions break existing imports and test mocks
findings.body:
Before this change, `mark_failed.py` exported several names:
- `mark_failed_threshold`
- `create_issue_platform_occurrence`
- `get_failure_reason`
- `get_monitor_environment_context`
- `SimpleCheckIn`

They have been moved and renamed: `try_incident_threshold` and `create_incident_occurrence` now live in new modules. Any existing callers will fail with ImportError or AttributeError. Examples are tests that patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.produce_occurrence_to_kafka` or import `get_failure_reason` from `mark_failed`.

Patches targeting the old module path will also silently stop intercepting the calls, so Kafka production would not be mocked. No test updates are included in this PR. Either update those callers and mocks, or re-export the old names from `mark_failed.py`.
